proof_roadmap: The reduction to Y = S (proof lines 5557-5560).
difficulty_reason: Let (S, omega_S^bullet) be as in Situation labelled situation-dualizing, let f : X -> Y be a proper morphism of schemes of finite type over S, let omega_X^bullet and omega_Y^bullet be dualizing complexes normalized relative to omega_S^bullet, and let a be the right adjoint of Lemma labelled lemma-twisted-inverse-image for f; the lemma asserts a canonical isomorphism a(omega_Y^bullet) = omega_X^bullet (statement lines 5540-5549). The proof writes p : X -> S and q : Y -> S for the structure morphisms and disposes first of the case where X and Y are separated over S, where the result follows from omega_X^bullet = p^!omega_S^bullet, omega_Y^bullet = q^!omega_S^bullet, f^! = a and f^! composed with q^! being p^! by Lemma labelled lemma-upper-shriek-composition (proof lines 5551-5560). The general case is reduced to Y = S by Lemma labelled lemma-good-over-both, after which X and Y are separated over S and the separated case applies. Reducing a proper morphism to the case of a separated base by choosing good dualizing complexes is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
